tests.name: process-runner-boundary-and-redaction

tests.name: packed-artifact-execution-npx-semantics
tests.evidence: The test harness packs BOTH workspace packages, co-installs image-mind+vision tarballs into an isolated npm prefix, asserts node_modules/.bin shims exist (including .cmd on Windows), and invokes every lifecycle step with `npx --no-install -- dsh-plugin-image-mind <command> ...` from that prefix. All package and data arguments remain separate argv values; no lifecycle step directly executes the package's lib/cli.js. Node 22/24 and Linux/Windows/macOS lanes all pass.

notes: Command UX shipped: `npx dsh-plugin-image-mind <install|update|status|uninstall> [--profile web] [--json] [--from <spec>] [--dsh-bin <path>] [-h|-V]`. Default compatibility target remains exact @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.1-rc.2; detected harness version is reported separately and no untested-version compatibility is claimed.
